subtitle: Back creative projects
promotionalText: Discover new ideas, back the campaigns you believe in and get your reward. If a campaign raises less than 80% of its goal, you get a full refund.
description:
IdeyaNest is a reward-based crowdfunding platform. Creators turn their ideas into campaigns, and backers help bring them to life in return for a product or an experience.

HOW IT WORKS
• A creator sets a funding goal and a deadline.
• You choose a reward and back the campaign. You pay when you pledge, on the payment provider's secure page.
• A campaign succeeds once it raises 80% of its goal.
• A campaign that ends below 80% refunds every backer in full.

This is not investment: backers receive no equity, interest or share of revenue — only a product or an experience.

FOR BACKERS
• Discover campaigns across fifteen categories, then search and filter them.
• Read the story, the rewards and the risks, and follow how much has been raised.
• Save the campaigns you like and follow their creators.
• Manage your pledges, your delivery address and your surveys in one place.
• Get notified about your pledges and the campaigns you follow.
• Saved campaigns and your pledges open even without a connection.

FOR CREATORS
• Start and edit a campaign from your phone: the basics, the story, the rewards and the FAQ.
• Follow backers, charts, the financial summary and surveys on your dashboard.

SECURITY
• Two-factor authentication.
• An app lock with Face ID, fingerprint or a PIN.
• IdeyaNest never stores your card details: payment happens on the provider's page.

The app is available in Azerbaijani, English, Russian and Turkish.
